svg.title: OrbitWatch
svg.desc: OrbitWatch: satellite and space-debris tracking with close-approach alerts. 35,503 objects catalogued, 32,510 with live orbits, MongoDB in 2 shards of 3 replicas, 170 automated tests.
svg.text: Satellite and space-debris tracking with close-approach alerts
A live 3D globe of 35,000+ tracked objects. Every few hours it
screens a watchlist for close approaches and computes the
probability of collision. An LLM agent then proposes an avoidance
burn behind physics guardrails, and a person has to approve it.
